title: 8day advanced hypertrophy
author: Lukáš Randus
desc: Unlock your muscle-building potential with the Boostcamp 8-Day Advanced Hypertrophy program. Over the course of 12 weeks, you'll engage in a carefully structured 5-day training split designed to maximize muscle growth and strength. Each session incorporates advanced techniques and progressive overload principles to push your limits and sculpt your physique. Get ready to challenge yourself, track your progress, and see real results as you elevate your training to the next level.
